cancel_order.notes: GAP. No official customer-facing MCP tool cancels a placed Shopify order (Customer Account MCP has only order status, store credit and request_return; UCP cancel_checkout/cancel_cart act on an unsubmitted checkout/cart, not an order). Policy lookup (policy_types terms_of_sale/refund) is the only defensible call; otherwise the right behaviour is no tool / hand off.

change_order.notes: GAP for placed orders: no order-edit tool. update_checkout/update_cart only apply if the 'order' is still an open checkout/cart (pre-purchase); Bitext utterances are mostly post-purchase.

change_shipping_address.notes: GAP for placed orders. update_checkout accepts fulfillment destinations (street_address) but only for an open checkout.

check_cancellation_fee.notes: Store policy question; policy_types e.g. terms_of_sale/refund. stripe.search_stripe_documentation is a distractor (Stripe integration docs, not store policy).

check_invoice.notes: Assumes invoices are issued via Stripe Billing. If the store's 'invoice' is just the Shopify order receipt, shopify_ucp.get_order is equally defensible. Legacy Stripe toolset has no retrieve-single-invoice tool.

check_payment_methods.notes: General 'which payment methods do you accept' is an FAQ/policy lookup. UCP checkout responses include payment handlers but require a cart/checkout. No Stripe list-payment-methods tool in the legacy toolset.

check_refund_policy.notes: Exact fit: policy_types=['refund'] (enum value exists in the schema).

complaint.notes: GAP. No customer-facing complaint/ticket-creation tool in the official servers retrieved (Intercom MCP cannot create conversations/tickets or reply to customers; Zendesk/Gorgias have no shipped official server). add_internal_note only annotates an existing conversation. GitHub/Notion are tempting distractors.

contact_customer_service.notes: policy_types=['contact'] returns phone/hours/address; the description itself lists 'What is your phone number?' and hours.

contact_human_agent.notes: GAP. No hand-off/escalation/assign tool in any official server retrieved. Returning contact details (policy_types=['contact']) or leaving an internal note are the closest real calls.

create_account.notes: GAP. Shopify Customer Account MCP has no sign-up tool (accounts are created by the shopper via the store's login flow). stripe.create_customer creates a Stripe billing customer, not a store account - a distractor.

delete_account.notes: GAP. No account-deletion tool. Privacy policy lookup (policy_types=['privacy']) is the only related call.

delivery_options.notes: Shipping policy lookup (policy_types=['shipping']). search_locations covers in-store pickup locations (only present on stores with locations; absent on kith.com). Checkout fulfillment options need a cart.

delivery_period.notes: Ambiguous intent: generic 'how long does shipping take' -> shipping policy; 'when will MY order arrive' -> order status tools. Graders should accept either family; consider splitting by utterance.

edit_account.notes: GAP. No profile-edit tool in Customer Account MCP (as listed unauthenticated).

get_invoice.notes: Same caveat as check_invoice. No tool returns/sends an invoice PDF; list_invoices returns invoice objects (which include hosted URLs in the Stripe API).

get_refund.notes: Two legitimate designs: customer-scoped return request on Shopify (refund follows the return), or merchant-authority refund of a Stripe PaymentIntent. Both are real; which one is 'right' depends on whether the assistant acts as the customer or the merchant.

newsletter_subscription.notes: GAP. No email-marketing server in the catalogue (an official Klaviyo/Mailchimp server would be needed; not retrieved).

payment_issue.notes: Investigating a failed/declined/double charge = list the customer's PaymentIntents. Disputes only if a chargeback is involved.

place_order.notes: Multi-step: (search_catalog/get_product) -> create_cart or create_checkout -> complete_checkout. Accept either creation tool as the first action; search_catalog first is also reasonable if the product is unidentified. Stripe payment links/invoices are distractors.

recover_password.notes: GAP. No password tool (Shopify's new customer accounts are passwordless one-time-code login; no MCP tool for it).

review.notes: GAP. No product-review / feedback tool in the official servers retrieved.

set_up_shipping_address.notes: GAP for a saved account address book (no address tools in Customer Account MCP listing). update_checkout sets a destination for a single open checkout.

switch_account.notes: GAP. No tool; account switching is a client/session action.

track_order.notes: Exact fit. get_order_status needs an order number; get_most_recent_order_status takes none; UCP get_order needs an order GID and its output schema includes fulfillment tracking_number/tracking_url.

track_refund.notes: GAP-ish. No list/retrieve-refund tool in the legacy Stripe toolset (the current hosted Stripe server reaches 'Retrieve a refund' only via generic stripe_api_read). Order status/get_order may surface refund adjustments (get_order output schema has 'adjustments'); not verified with a live order.
